jobs.title: Director / Sr. Director of Engineering - Advanced Packaging
jobs.description:
About Thintronics

Thintronics is solving one of the defining challenges in modern computing: moving massive amounts of data and power between chips at unprecedented speeds and densities.
As Moore's Law slows, performance is increasingly defined by advanced packaging, chiplet architectures, and high-density substrates. Thintronics has developed breakthrough dielectric materials that enable unprecedented interconnect density, signal integrity, and power delivery for next generation semiconductor packages.

Our technology spans chemistry, materials science, semiconductor processing, and electrical engineering, creating new possibilities for AI accelerators, high-performance computing, advanced networking, and 5G/6G infrastructure. We partner with leading semiconductor companies, including integrated device manufacturers (IDMs), foundries, substrate manufacturers, and outsourced assembly and testing (OSAT) partners, to help shape the future of advanced packaging.

Joining Thintronics means joining a small, highly accomplished team where technical excellence, curiosity, and innovation drive everything we do.

About the Role

Thintronics is seeking an exceptional Director / Sr Director of Engineering, Advanced Packaging
to lead the integration of our breakthrough materials into the world's most advanced semiconductor packaging platforms.

Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, this individual will define and execute Thintronics' advanced packaging strategy, serving as the technical leader responsible for translating cutting edge materials innovation into manufacturable, high volume semiconductor solutions.

This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role requiring deep expertise in advanced packaging, semiconductor process integration, customer engagement, and cross functional technical leadership. The successful candidate will work closely with customers, manufacturing partners, and internal R&D teams to accelerate commercialization while helping build Thintronics' packaging organization for future growth.

This role carries equal responsibility for the direct management of Thintronics' engineering organization, including the Process Integration team, Substrate Manufacturer and OSAT Engagement, and the Electrical Engineering, ECAD, Mechanical Engineering, and Reliability functions.

This position offers a rare opportunity to influence product strategy, customer success, and the future direction of one of the semiconductor industry's most promising materials technology companies.

What You'll Do

Technical Leadership

Define and lead Thintronics' advanced semiconductor packaging strategy.
Develop technology roadmaps for integrating Thintronics' dielectric materials into next generation package architectures.
Drive process integration strategies that maximize electrical performance, manufacturability, reliability, and yield.
Identify technical risks and develop mitigation strategies throughout product development and customer qualification.

Customer & Partner Engagement

Serve as the senior technical interface for strategic customers and development partners.
Lead technical reviews with leading semiconductor manufacturers, foundries, OSATs, substrate suppliers, and ecosystem partners.
Support customer evaluations, qualifications, and production ramps.
Represent Thintronics at executive level technical discussions and industry conferences.

Process Integration

Lead development and optimization of advanced packaging integration flows.
Guide process development across dielectric deposition, patterning, metallization, via formation, reliability testing, and package integration.
Drive Design of Experiments (DOE), root cause analysis, process characterization, and yield improvement initiatives.
Establish best practices for process control, manufacturability, and reliability.

Product Development

Collaborate closely with Chemistry, Materials Science, Device Engineering, Reliability, Manufacturing, and Applications Engineering teams.
Translate customer requirements into product specifications and future technology development.
Help prioritize R&D investments based on customer needs and market opportunities.

Organizational Leadership

Build and mentor a world class Advanced Packaging engineering organization, with direct management responsibility across Process Integration, Substrate Manufacturer & OSAT Engagement, Electrical Engineering, ECAD, Mechanical Engineering, and Reliability.
Recruit, develop, and coach high performing engineers.
Establish technical standards, engineering processes, and best practices.
Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Strategic Leadership

Contribute to Thintronics' long term technology and commercialization strategy.
Support technical due diligence with customers, investors, and strategic partners.
Evaluate emerging semiconductor packaging technologies and competitive developments.
Work closely with executive leadership to identify future market opportunities.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

Ph.D. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline.
12+ years of experience in semiconductor packaging, process integration, or advanced packaging technologies.
Demonstrated technical leadership in advanced semiconductor packaging within a leading semiconductor manufacturer, substrate supplier, OSAT, equipment company, or materials company.
Deep expertise in semiconductor package development, process integration, and manufacturing.
Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and cross functional technical programs.
Prior experience directly managing a team of direct reports, with a demonstrated track record of hiring, developing, and leading engineering staff.
Working knowledge of electrical engineering fundamentals, including signal integrity and power integrity design trade offs, as they relate to advanced package design and integration.
Familiarity with design for manufacturability (DFM), design rule check (DRC), and other ECAD/mechanical design verification practices used in package development.
Strong customer facing experience supporting technology development and commercialization.
Exceptional analytical, communication, and leadership skills.
Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast paced, entrepreneurial environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in several of the following areas is highly desirable:
Advanced packaging (2.1D/2.5D/3D Heterogeneous integration)
Chiplet architectures
Redistribution Layers (RDL) and Interposer technologies
Standard build-up film and inter-layer dielectrics (ILD)
Package reliability validation and testing
Process integration (semi-additive, additive, embedded trench, damascene)
Design of Experiments (DOE) and Statistical Process Control (SPC)
Customer qualification and technology transfer

Experience working with one or more of the following is particularly valuable:
Leading semiconductor manufacturers
Advanced substrate manufacturers
OSATs
Semiconductor materials suppliers
Semiconductor equipment companies

Why This Role Matters

This is one of the most strategically important technical leadership positions within Thintronics.
The Director / Sr Director of Engineering, Advanced Packaging will play a central role in determining how our breakthrough materials become commercial products adopted by the world's leading semiconductor companies. Success in this position will directly influence customer adoption, product commercialization, intellectual property development, and the long-term growth of the company.

For the right individual, this represents a rare opportunity to help shape the future of semiconductor packaging while building a new technical organization from the ground up.

Compensation & Benefits

Thintronics offers a highly competitive compensation package designed to reward both immediate impact and long-term value creation. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $165,000 to $240,000
, depending on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated expertise. As an early leader in a rapidly growing deep technology company, this role also offers meaningful long term equity upside and the opportunity to help build a transformative semiconductor business.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for:
Participation in the Thintronics Stock Option Plan, subject to Board approval
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) retirement plan
Unlimited paid time off
Paid company holidays
Professional development opportunities

Actual compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate's experience, technical expertise, leadership background, and overall fit for the role.

Corning Environmental Technologies is seeking a Department Head of Die Manufacturing to lead the die manufacturing operations that produce the extrusion die tooling at the heart of our ceramic substrate and particulate filter products. Operating in a machine shop / high-precision machining / chemical manufacturing environment, this leader owns the manufacturing engineering strategy, execution, and organizational capability of a die operation that is mission-critical to Corning's global CET manufacturing network. Experience in forming and extrusion tooling, ideally in ceramic honeycomb substrate manufacturing or a comparable precision extrusion die manufacturing environment, with working knowledge of CNC, EDM, die design (CAD/CAM), and precision finishing processes.
Strong background in PCPD (Product/Process Commercialization & Development) or a similar stage-gate discipline, along with fluency in Lean, structured problem-solving methodologies, and Engineering Excellence practices and standards.

You will work directly with senior stakeholders to identify the opportunities that matter most, determine what is viable, and lead solutions from idea through production. You will help move Broadridge from experimentation to scaled impact—building reusable AI capabilities that improve how we operate, serve clients, and prepare for what comes next.

You will be an exceptional collaborator with strong conviction: someone who brings people together around ambitious outcomes, welcomes rigorous debate, and never settles for a merely adequate solution when a better one can be built.

Identify and shape the most consequential AI opportunities across Broadridge, working directly with senior business leaders, clients, product teams, and technology organizations.

OCI is seeking a Senior Manager of Firmware Management to lead teams responsible for the strategy, delivery, validation, and lifecycle management of firmware across our global cloud infrastructure. This leader will manage engineers who build and operate firmware solutions for server platforms and critical hardware components, including BIOS/BMC, storage, networking, accelerators, and platform security technologies.

Working across hardware engineering, infrastructure, security, supply-chain, and operations teams, you will drive safe firmware release processes—from vendor qualification and compatibility testing through staged deployment, monitoring, rollback, and incident response.

About NetDocuments

That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies
Five-time Top Workplace USA winner
Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace
Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

NetDocuments is seeking a Senior Manager, Datacenter & Cloud Applications to lead a team and function that will evolve alongside our infrastructure strategy. Initially, you’ll lead the day-to-day operations of our Datacenter Infrastructure team, ensuring our on-premise environments operate with a high degree of reliability, security, and scalability. As our public cloud journey matures, you’ll build and lead a team of cloud application engineers who operate as hands-on AWS engineers and trusted operational partners to our broader engineering organization. This role is ideal for a leader who can operate credibly across both physical infrastructure and cloud-native environments and who is excited to actively shape the transition between them.

You will:

Datacenter & Infrastructure Operations

Lead day-to-day datacenter operations as part of the Cloud Infrastructure organization, ensuring stability, reliability, and performance across our physical environments.
Oversee operational practices across hardware, network, compute, and supporting infrastructure.
Partner with Software Engineering, Cloud Engineering, and Architecture teams to maintain reliable and scalable infrastructure supporting NetDocuments products.
Ensure infrastructure operations align with security and compliance requirements, including SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001.
Maintain and evolve business continuity and disaster recovery plans as infrastructure and business needs change.

Cloud Transformation & Application Operations

Lead the evolution of the team from traditional datacenter and infrastructure operations toward AWS-native cloud application engineering.
Manage and operate AWS PaaS services supporting NetDocuments SaaS applications as our public cloud footprint expands.
Establish cloud-native operational practices that improve reliability, scalability, automation, and engineering efficiency.
Position the team as hands-on engineering contributors capable of building and operating directly against cloud-native services.
Partner with product engineering teams to align Cloud Operations capabilities with product roadmaps and technical priorities.

Observability, Reliability & Incident Management

Establish and maintain observability standards and practices across infrastructure and cloud environments in partnership with key stakeholders.
Ensure appropriate logging, monitoring, telemetry, and operational visibility are incorporated into infrastructure and application environments.
Provide leadership for incident response subject matter experts in alignment with the established Incident Management process.
Identify opportunities to improve production reliability through automation, operational standards, and proactive infrastructure improvements.
Ensure Cloud Operations standards for observability, incident response, reliability, and security are represented within product engineering teams.

People Leadership & Team Development

Lead, mentor, and develop engineers through a significant evolution in the team’s technical responsibilities and operating model.
Build development plans that help engineers expand from datacenter and infrastructure operations into AWS-native platform engineering.

Most AI is answer-grade: fast, fluent and unaccountable. That works in a chat window, but not in a command post, where the real question is "what would have to be true for this to be wrong?" and a confident wrong answer has real consequences.

Our client builds decision-grade AI instead. It presents competing hypotheses rather than a single confident narrative, and uses graduated authority that knows the difference between advising an analyst and orchestrating an action. It is model-agnostic by design, using frontier intelligence without depending on frontier knowledge, and runs Kubernetes-native from cloud to disconnected edge.

While much of the industry races to make models sound more certain, this team is building a system that makes certainty earn its place. The interface asks the analyst to commit before the machine reveals, nothing leaves the platform without passing an integrity gate, and sometimes the agent's job is to slow you down. Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

Snap Engineering teams build fun and technically sophisticated products that reach hundreds of millions of Snapchatters around the world every day. We are deeply committed to the well being of everyone in our global community, and our values are at the root of everything we do. We move fast, with precision, and always execute with privacy at the forefront.

At Snap, our products empower people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. We believe that diverse backgrounds and voices help us create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Software Engineering at Snap.

What You’ll Do

Lead, manage, and mentor a team of software engineers. Create an environment where people can do their best work, grow their careers, and feel included and supported.
Set the technical vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable goals for a product engineering area aligned to company priorities.
Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Operations, and other Engineering teams to understand customer needs, define product requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and deliver high quality experiences.
Design, implement, and scale critical product components and services across the stack, including backend services, distributed systems, client applications, and data platforms as appropriate for the team.
Drive technical execution across a portfolio of initiatives, from near term product launches to longer term investments in architecture, platform capabilities, and engineering excellence.
Establish a high bar for availability, scalability, performance, privacy, security, operational excellence, and cost management.
Use product and engineering insights to identify opportunities, make sound decisions in ambiguous situations, and improve customer and business outcomes.
Provide technical direction that influences work beyond your immediate team and helps engineering organizations operate more effectively.
Hire, retain, and develop high caliber engineers and leaders while building a diverse and inclusive team.
Communicate clearly with senior leaders and cross functional partners, ensuring alignment on priorities, risks, decisions, and outcomes.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Excellent programming and software design skills, including debugging, performance analysis, testing, and technical decision making.
Proven experience building and operating highly available products or services at significant scale.
Experience architecting, designing, and developing distributed systems and modern product experiences.
Strong product judgment and the ability to connect technical choices to customer value and business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous problems, set direction, and lead complex initiatives from strategy through delivery and operation.
Strong collaboration, communication, mentorship, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience developing engineering talent, building effective teams, and fostering a culture of accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
Ability to learn new concepts and technologies quickly and apply them effectively.
Experience with one or more modern programming languages, such as Java, C++, Go, Python, Swift, Kotlin, or JavaScript.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics, or equivalent years of practical work experience.
10+ years of post Bachelor’s software development experience; or a Master’s degree in a technical field plus 9+ years of post graduate software development experience; or a PhD in a related technical field plus 6+ years of post graduate software development experience.
2+ years of experience as an engineering manager or technical leader, including experience setting technical direction for engineering projects or organizations.
Experience architecting, designing, and developing distributed systems and business critical products.
Experience leading, mentoring, and scaling engineering teams to consistently deliver complex, high impact work.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree in a technical field such as computer science.
Experience building consumer products used at global scale.
Experience partnering with senior executives and management across a globally distributed organization, and exercising sound judgment in a fast changing environment.
Experience applying artificial intelligence or machine learning to product development, personalization, recommendations, search, or engineering productivity.
A track record of delivering in rapidly changing, highly collaborative, multi site, and multi stakeholder environments.
Ability to create a compelling vision for the future, communicate with clarity, and lead with a collaborative approach.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.

To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, where applicable).

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!
